additional_info.subject: ID0464018-DC/Si-D/PL-[MP / R6 170002262] Error : DC2_CableTempSensor_XD101 CRM:02889000888
additional_info.body:
Dear Poland service team,
Please measure on-site and confirm the values by measuring directly on the cables coming from the CCS. If you see that the value doesn't change with charging, then the CCS is faulty and needs replacement. Otherwise, please measure the 1kOhm until you reach the KF13/14.
P1 to P2 and N1 to N2
If you get 1kOhm until the State Monitor, please try replacing the grey connector with a spare one (they have some connectors on the EcoGs that are not used at all)
Or replace the State Monitor.
I recommend you to take spare CCS and StateMonitor.
Mit Freundlichen Grüßen/ Melhores Cumprimentos/ Best Regards
Harun Ar Rashid
Technical Support Specialist (eMobility)
Av. 25 de Abril 201, 2845-547, Amora, Portugal.
Email: harun.ar-rashid.ext@siemens.com

additional_info.subject: Observation completed
additional_info.body:
The station was monitored for one month. The error occurred only once at a single charging point. We do not consider this a repair/cable replacement issue. The customer has received feedback.
If the error recurs persistently in subsequent months, we will revisit the issue in a new ticket.
